message:
Greetings,

Having read of your trevails in these posts, I am certain I would not want to be forced to use this service with no competitive alternative.  This story seems to be one that is ripe for a news organization with the person-power and resources to expose these totalitarian-like tactics.  I would suggest someone with documented facts and witness testimonials send the relevant information to 60 Minutes, or perhaps one of the networks nightly news devisions.  Bringing this story to the wider public eye seems to be the necessary ingredient that is missing.

Also, put all of your communications in writing.  The power of a well-crafted letter cannot be emphasized enough.  Good luck, I hope you all are fortunate enough to get some level of justice.
